idea: Little science wonder – FLOAT or SINK? (PLAYROOM, at the small round wooden table with a big clear glass bowl of water): a yellow rubber duck drops into the bowl with a SPLASH right in front of Baby Jimmy and floats ('Splash! Wow! My duck can float!'); he drops a gray rock – PLOP – and it sinks down, down, down to the bottom ('Sink, sink, sink!'); copy-me 'Float – arms up high! Sink – bend down low!'; he holds up a red apple and asks the viewer 'Float or sink? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – the apple FLOATS ('It floats! It floats! Yay!'); lesson 'Duck and apple float! The rock sinks!'. Loop: the hook framing again with the duck and the apple floating and the rock on the bottom, bye-bye wave.
title: Splash! Float or Sink? 🦆 Science for Toddlers with Baby Jimmy | Crayon Babies
description:
Splash! Baby Jimmy's yellow rubber duck lands in a big bowl of water – and it floats! What about a rock? And a red apple? Guess with Jimmy: float or sink?

🎬 What happens in this video:
🦆 Splash! The duck floats on top of the water
🪨 Plop! The rock sinks – down, down, down!
🙌 Float – arms up high! Sink – bend down low!
🍎 The red apple… float or sink? Shout your answer!
🎉 It floats! Yay!
👋 Float and sink – bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: float • sink • down • first science for toddlers – things that float stay on top, things that sink go to the bottom

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun little science sing-along for toddlers and preschoolers: Baby Jimmy drops a rubber duck, a rock and an apple into a clear bowl of water to find out what floats and what sinks, and little viewers guess along.
